title: Keto Beef Casserole
description: A hearty and satisfying casserole dish made with ground beef, gooey cheese, and a crispy polish topping.
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the casserole and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the mixture with the shredded cheese.
Sprinkle the crushed polish on top of the cheese.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
